name: Inraku Relaxation ~Hosoi Yubisaki no Technique~
original_name: 淫楽リラクゼーション ～細い指先のテクニック～
source:
To relieve the fatigue of his daily transportation job... Our protagonist, Arata Satoru, frequents ear cleaning and massage parlors.

One day, he hurts his back at work and heads to a new place for the first time to seek help. He walks into a parlor called "Anriru" without doing his research... and it turns out to be a slightly erotic and unusual beauty parlor. And it seems...if the girls like you, they'll provide you with any kind of service.

Enthralled by the mysterious charm of the parlor and the girls, Satoshi starts frequenting the place regularly...

Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/pro/work/=/product_id/VJ010725.html/?unique_op=af&utm_medium=affiliate&utm_source=vndb.org%2F]DLsite[/url]
translation:
為了消除平日跑運輸累積的疲勞，主角新田聰經常光顧採耳店和按摩店。

一天，他在工作時傷到了腰，便前往一家新店求助。他沒有事先調查，就走進了名為「Anriru」的店鋪……結果發現那是一家有些色情、又十分特別的美容沙龍。而且，只要店裡的女孩喜歡他，她們似乎什麼服務都願意提供。

聰被這家沙龍和女孩們神秘的魅力吸引，開始定期光顧這裡……
